BP-PY-1.name: Bare Except Clause
BP-PY-1.detection_notes: Match `except:` or broad `except Exception` / `except BaseException` blocks that pass, only log without re-raise, or continue without recording the exception type. Prefer specific exception types.

BP-PY-2.name: Except Pass
BP-PY-2.detection_notes: Match except handlers whose suite is solely `pass` (optionally with a comment). Flag library and request-path code more strictly than top-level CLI mains.

BP-PY-3.name: Raise Generic Exception
BP-PY-3.detection_notes: Match `raise Exception(...)` / `raise BaseException(...)` outside tests. Prefer project-defined exceptions or stdlib types (ValueError, RuntimeError, OSError).

BP-PY-4.name: Mutable Default Argument
BP-PY-4.detection_notes: Match FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef defaults that are List, Dict, Set, or Call to list/dict/set. Suggest `None` + assign inside body.

BP-PY-5.name: Wildcard Import
BP-PY-5.detection_notes: Match ImportFrom with names containing `*`. Allow only `__init__.py` re-export patterns if explicitly documented; default flag in app code.

BP-PY-6.name: assert Used For Runtime Validation
BP-PY-6.detection_notes: Match assert on request/CLI inputs, authz checks, or path validation in non-test files. Prefer `if` + raise ValueError/HTTPException.

BP-PY-7.name: open Without Context Manager
BP-PY-7.detection_notes: Match Call to open/Path.open assigned to a name without being the context expression of a With. Ignore temporary open().read() one-liners if closed by GC policy—prefer always requiring with.

BP-PY-8.name: subprocess With shell=True
BP-PY-8.detection_notes: Match subprocess.run/Popen/call/check_output/check_call with keyword shell=True. Prefer argv list and shell=False. Overlaps CWE-78 when input is untrusted.

BP-PY-9.name: os.system Or os.popen
BP-PY-9.detection_notes: Match Attribute calls os.system / os.popen. Prefer subprocess with list argv.

BP-PY-10.name: pickle Loads Untrusted Data
BP-PY-10.detection_notes: Match pickle.load/loads, _pickle, cloudpickle on non-constant sources (request body, file from user path, cache). Prefer json or a safe schema. Related to CWE-502.

BP-PY-11.name: yaml.load Without SafeLoader
BP-PY-11.detection_notes: Match yaml.load(...) missing Loader=yaml.SafeLoader (or CSafeLoader). Prefer yaml.safe_load. PyYAML 6+ requires Loader= keyword—still flag FullLoader on untrusted input when policy is strict.

BP-PY-12.name: eval Or exec On Dynamic Input
BP-PY-12.detection_notes: Match eval/exec/compile(..., 'exec') with non-literal arguments. Flag request/env-derived strings especially hard.

BP-PY-13.name: Hardcoded Secret In Source
BP-PY-13.detection_notes: Heuristic: assignments to names matching password/secret/api_key/token/private_key with string literals that look like secrets (length, entropy). Exclude test fixtures and obvious placeholders (change

BP-PY-14.name: requests Without Timeout
BP-PY-14.detection_notes: Match requests.get/post/put/patch/delete/request/Session.* without timeout keyword. Prefer explicit timeout=(connect, read).

BP-PY-15.name: httpx Async Client Not Closed
BP-PY-15.detection_notes: Match httpx.AsyncClient() assigned without With/AsyncWith context and without await client.aclose() on known paths. Prefer async with httpx.AsyncClient().

BP-PY-16.name: Flask DEBUG True In Production Code
BP-PY-16.detection_notes: Match app.run(debug=True), FLASK_DEBUG/DEBUG = True in settings modules, or app.config['DEBUG'] = True outside tests. Prefer env-driven config defaulting false.

BP-PY-17.name: Flask SECRET_KEY Hardcoded
BP-PY-17.detection_notes: Match app.secret_key = '...' or SECRET_KEY = '...' in Flask config modules with non-empty literals. Prefer os.environ / secrets management.

BP-PY-18.name: Flask Route Missing Methods Restriction
BP-PY-18.detection_notes: Heuristic: route handlers that call request.form/get_json/POST-like logic without methods=['POST',...] or methods list. Flag CSRF-sensitive form posts especially.

BP-PY-19.name: Flask jsonify Error Leaks Exception
BP-PY-19.detection_notes: Match Flask errorhandler/register_error_handler bodies returning str(exc), traceback.format_exc(), or repr(e) in JSON/HTML responses.

BP-PY-20.name: Flask send_file User Path
BP-PY-20.detection_notes: Match flask.send_file/send_from_directory where path/filename comes from request.args/form/view args without safe_join + root check. Complements CWE-22.

BP-PY-21.name: Django DEBUG True In Settings
BP-PY-21.detection_notes: Match DEBUG = True in settings.py / settings/*.py excluding tests and local_settings patterns named explicitly. Prefer env var.

BP-PY-22.name: Django SECRET_KEY Hardcoded
BP-PY-22.detection_notes: Match SECRET_KEY = '...' string literals in Django settings modules. Prefer environment or secrets backend.

BP-PY-23.name: Django ALLOWED_HOSTS Empty Or Star
BP-PY-23.detection_notes: Match ALLOWED_HOSTS = [] or ['*'] / ["*"] in settings. Flag * always; empty list when DEBUG is False nearby.

BP-PY-24.name: Django raw SQL With Format
BP-PY-24.detection_notes: Match Model.objects.raw, connection.cursor().execute with JoinedStr/BinOp/Call format on SQL. Prefer params= binding. Complements CWE-89.

BP-PY-25.name: Django mark_safe On Dynamic Data
BP-PY-25.detection_notes: Match django.utils.safestring.mark_safe or format_html misuse with variables from request/model fields. Prefer auto-escaping templates. Complements CWE-79.

BP-PY-26.name: Django csrf_exempt On State-Changing View
BP-PY-26.detection_notes: Match csrf_exempt decorator on views that handle POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE or use request.POST. Allow documented webhook exceptions with additional auth checks.

BP-PY-27.name: Django Mass Assignment From request.POST
BP-PY-27.detection_notes: Match Model(**request.POST), Model.objects.create(**request.data), form.save with unrestricted fields, or serializer without Meta.fields. Prefer explicit fields / ModelForm.

BP-PY-28.name: Django N+1 Query In Loop
BP-PY-28.detection_notes: Heuristic: for-loop over queryset accessing `.foreign` or reverse relations without prior select_related/prefetch_related on the queryset definition. Review-only; cannot prove all graphs.

BP-PY-29.name: FastAPI Depends On Mutable Global
BP-PY-29.detection_notes: Match global/nonlocal writes or module-level dict/list mutation inside route handlers/dependencies. Prefer request-scoped deps and proper stores.

BP-PY-30.name: FastAPI Blocking I/O In Async Route
BP-PY-30.detection_notes: Match async def route/dependency bodies calling time.sleep, requests.*, sync sqlalchemy session, open().read large, or subprocess without asyncio. Prefer asyncio.sleep, httpx.AsyncClient, run_in_execu

BP-PY-31.name: FastAPI response_model Disabled Unsafely
BP-PY-31.detection_notes: Heuristic: FastAPI route returns SQLAlchemy/Django model instances without response_model= or response_model_exclude. Prefer Pydantic response models.

BP-PY-32.name: Starlette FileResponse User Path
BP-PY-32.detection_notes: Match starlette.responses.FileResponse or StaticFiles usage with path from path params/query without resolve+prefix check. Complements CWE-22.

BP-PY-33.name: Jinja2 autoescape Disabled
BP-PY-33.detection_notes: Match jinja2.Environment(autoescape=False) or select_autoescape not used for .html templates. Complements CWE-79.

BP-PY-34.name: Jinja2 Markup Or safe Filter On Variables
BP-PY-34.detection_notes: Match Markup(...), |safe, |forceescape misuse in templates or Python. Flag non-literal arguments to Markup.

BP-PY-35.name: SQLAlchemy text With F-String
BP-PY-35.detection_notes: Match text(f"..."), text("...".format(...)), or execute with concatenated SQL. Prefer text("... WHERE id = :id") with bindparams. Complements CWE-89.

BP-PY-36.name: SQLAlchemy Session Not Closed
BP-PY-36.detection_notes: Match Session() / SessionLocal() without with/contextlib.closing and without .close() on exit paths. Prefer session scope context managers.

BP-PY-37.name: DB-API Cursor Execute With Percent Format
BP-PY-37.detection_notes: Match execute("...%s..." % (...)) or execute(f"...") patterns. Prefer execute(sql, params) binding. Complements CWE-89.

BP-PY-38.name: asyncio create_task Without Reference
BP-PY-38.detection_notes: Match create_task/ensure_future calls whose return value is unused (Expr statement). Prefer storing tasks and awaiting/gather with exception handling.

BP-PY-39.name: time.sleep In Async Function
BP-PY-39.detection_notes: Match time.sleep in AsyncFunctionDef bodies. Prefer await asyncio.sleep.

BP-PY-40.name: threading Without Join Or Shutdown
BP-PY-40.detection_notes: Match threading.Thread(...).start() without later join/daemon policy documentation. Review-only heuristic for non-daemon workers.

BP-PY-41.name: pytest assert With Side Effects Only
BP-PY-41.detection_notes: Heuristic: test_* functions that call APIs but have no assert/pytest.raises/unittest asserts. Low confidence; style signal.

BP-PY-42.name: unittest Assert Without Context On Raises
BP-PY-42.detection_notes: Match test functions with try/except AssertionError or broad except used to 'expect' failures. Prefer assertRaises context managers.

BP-PY-43.name: requirements Without Pins
BP-PY-43.detection_notes: Parse requirements*.txt lines that are bare package names without ==, ~=, >= constraints (excluding -e and -r includes). Prefer pinned lock files for apps.

BP-PY-44.name: Import Deprecated stdlib Module
BP-PY-44.detection_notes: Match imports of known deprecated modules: imp, asyncore, asynchat, cgi (3.13+), telnetlib, etc. Prefer modern replacements.

BP-PY-45.name: sys.path Mutation At Runtime
BP-PY-45.detection_notes: Match sys.path.insert/append/extend outside tests and packaging bootstrap. Prefer installable packages / PYTHONPATH at process start.

BP-PY-46.name: print Debugging In Library Code
BP-PY-46.detection_notes: Match print(...) in modules that are not __main__ guards and not tests. Prefer logging module. Info severity.

BP-PY-47.name: logging With String Format Before Logger
BP-PY-47.detection_notes: Match logger.debug/info/warning/error(f"...") or .format before call. Prefer logger.info("x %s", val) for lazy formatting and safer structured logs.

BP-PY-48.name: CORS Allow Origins Star With Credentials
BP-PY-48.detection_notes: Match FastAPI CORSMiddleware, flask-cors, django-cors-headers configs combining allow_origins=['*'] / True with allow_credentials=True.

BP-PY-49.name: TLS Verification Disabled
BP-PY-49.detection_notes: Match requests/httpx/urllib3 verify=False, ssl._create_unverified_context, or CERT_NONE in production code paths.

BP-PY-50.name: Django/Flask CSRF Or Session Cookie Insecure Flags
BP-PY-50.detection_notes: Match SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE/CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE/SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY = False or missing Secure when DEBUG is False. Flask: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE False.
